key_insight: TextSeal2 strengthens distortion-free LLM watermarking while preserving output diversity, the target output distribution, and speculative decoding acceptance rates.
engineering_relevance: It enables watermarking compatible with speculative decoding, with no measurable inference latency added in the reported evaluation and no post-logits optimization.
method: Merge multiple watermark keys into one virtual key rather than randomly selecting among keys.
Couple the virtual key to fresh noise using AutoMark’s Gaussian copula.
Verify speculative drafts with an additional exponential race over leftover draft races, exploiting memorylessness.
evidence_signal: Across three LLMs at a false-positive rate of 0.001, TextSeal2 improves detection over TextSeal by 8–22 percentage points for 100-token answers at equal diversity; under speculative decoding, gains for 200-token answers are 18 points over TextSeal and 22 over textGrain at the same acceptance rate.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness to paraphrasing or other adversarial edits, so deployment should validate these separately.
paper_title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
